name: primitives-texts-morphing
blurb: Text smoothly animates between words in a cycling list.
description: Morphs between a series of words with a canvas or SVG-based animation that blends letter shapes.
use_when: Dynamic taglines or feature descriptions cycling through related terms.
avoid_when: Large word lists — morphing becomes choppy and hard to read.
a11y: Only the current morph frame is readable. No pause or pause control.
